epics.title: Closed Strains Access Control
epics.jtbd: When I query closed strains, I want the system to filter access based on my Moodle department and courses, so that access restrictions are automatically enforced.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Defect rate in unauthorized closed strain access attempts
requirements: R1: Automatically restrict access to closed strains based on the user's Moodle department and courses.

slices.title: Implement Closed Strains Access Control API logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing strains access for this epic, I want to filter strains by Moodle department and courses, so that access restrictions are automatically enforced.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user authenticated via Moodle, When they request closed strains, Then the system only returns strains matching their department or courses.
Given a user requests closed strains, When they do not have matching department or courses, Then the unauthorized strains are omitted from the result.
Given a developer verifies the implementation, When tests are run, Then positive, negative, and boundary test scenarios pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Test coverage for closed strains access control

requirements: R1: Verify EPIDEMIOLOGIST role instead of 'Эпидемиология' department when signing a dossier.

slices.title: Fix dossier signature role validation in EmployeeDossierController
slices.jtbd: When implementing dossier signing authorization for this epic, I want to verify the user role instead of department, so that the signature right is correctly bound.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user with the EPIDEMIOLOGIST role, When they submit a signature for a dossier, Then the system accepts it.
Given a user without the role, When they submit a signature, Then the system denies it.
Given a developer verifies the implementation, When tests are run, Then positive, negative, and boundary test scenarios pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Defect rate in dossier signature authorization
